questions.question: What is Amazon EC2?
questions.answer: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) is a web service that provides secure, resizable compute capacity in the cloud. It allows users to rent virtual computers on which to run their own computer applications.

questions.question: What is AWS Lambda?
questions.answer: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that runs your code in response to events and automatically manages the underlying compute resources for you.

questions.question: What is Amazon S3?
questions.answer: Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) is an object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance.

questions.question: What is the difference between Security Group and NACL?
questions.answer: Security Groups are stateful and operate at the instance level, while Network ACLs are stateless and operate at the subnet level. Security Groups only support allow rules, while NACLs support both allow and deny rules.
